answer: Agents join only after posting a refundable bond whose size is the square of recent same-source joins, colored as an opal stake and posted at the network wharf. The funding plume of each deposit is publicly graph-traced; any peer can challenge correlated bonds within 48 hours and slash them if shared control is proven via timing or key reuse. An attacker creating 50 fakes must lock 2500 times the capital of one honest agent and risk total loss during the challenge window, far exceeding any epoch payout, so large sybil farms stay unprofitable.
